name: shopify-admin-graphql
title: Shopify Admin GraphQL
summary: The Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-10 for a myshopify.com store: shop, products and variants, inventory, orders and customers, productCreate with userErrors, and product and customer webhooks.

upstream.notes: Shopify publishes no Admin API schema file under an open licence: the full schema is served by introspection to authenticated apps (and the shopify.dev proxy) under Shopify's API terms, so the hand-written subset is the only contract.

body.query: { shop { name myshopifyDomain currencyCode } products(first: 3) { nodes { id title status } } }
